request.title: Wiki view layout conventions
request.content:
- `src/views/WikiView.vue` (wiki UI): sidebar + main + assistant panel live in one component; options API in a plain `<script>` block plus a `<script setup>` block for imports (both are used).
- Resizable panels use `src/components/layout/VerticalSplitter.vue` (radix-vue): props `split`, `showLeft`, `showRight`, `showHandle`, `persistKey`, `panels` (`{ left|right: { minSize, defaultSize, collapsible, class, style } }`). Persisted layouts go to localStorage key `splitter-layout:<persistKey>`.
- Sidebar collapse follows `DesktopSidebar.vue`: width transition `w-12`/`w-16` collapsed vs `w-64` expanded with an explicit toggle button (`fa-angle-left` / `fa-angle-right`), never hover-based.
